يعتوروا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَوِرُوا (yaʕtawirū) /jaʕ.ta.wi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# يُعْتَوَرُوا (yuʕtawarū) /juʕ.ta.wa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
